jinkou.month_general_scope: jinkou.overview.month_general是依中气确定的月将本位；yuejiang是月将加时后落在地分的将神，对应四位将神行。两支可不同，解释分别说明，不将落地分的支称为中气月将本位。快照使用月将本位、将神落地分两个标签。
jinkou.transmission_progression_scope: 探原PDF110–111三传连茹／间断：sequence_direction只指支序；raw_branch_empty_conditional_*仅在支神本空适用假设下释读，不把坐空或天将天空替代本空。effective_direction和comprehensive_judgement仍未裁定，不从进退字样推成败、概率或应期。
jinkou.published_term_dates_scope: 逐项读取实际solar_term_dependencies中的published_date_reference：按固定UTC+08对照香港天文台1901—2100逐日表，日期相符只表示同一天，不认证交气秒数或全部历法。date_mismatch保留两日期，不能称官方一致或移动交界凑表；outside_published_range是无资料，不能说相符或不符。与分析时区、真太阳钟、历史时间约定及未来闰秒假设分列，金口诀仍按同次四位解释。
jinkou.seasonal_evidence_scope: 探原季节五态用本次月建支，不用月将支。当前季月整月配置分别计算支神、天将固有五行和地盘五态，日干五态不替代它们。真空／半空只列支神本空与季节状态的条件，天空天将及坐空不替换本空；季末十八日异法、扶助冲剋及角色例外后的有效真半未裁，不把原文效力折扣说成成功率。金口诀本课与附带六壬分开，不能借本层代替金口诀日下五态或综合取用。
jinkou.branch_stars_scope: 京本PDF118–120所选七项神煞只给历法目标与三位本支事实。驿马条用月建支，天赦比完整日干支；不以名称或条件推出现实结局，不借六壬日马、月将或贵神落宫替代。
jinkou.god_yin_scope: 类神阴神按实际天将所乘支再查上神，天乙依所选昼夜表互取；与四课第二、四课的阴神称谓分层。年命上神缺项保留未知，季节本空事实不替代有效空亡及日辰德合相生，综合类神可用性仍未裁。金口诀附带六壬盘的本层不替代金口诀四位取用。
jinkou.natal_course_scope: jinkou.natal_course以已确认本命支另起完整四位课；未给本命支及明确出生年干支则course=null。它不是出生时刻命盘，不需要猜生时、性别或岁序；本命支作派生地分，主课原地分保留，日干、占时、月将、昼夜选择不改。不因重复提问自动换将或换日，也不宣称原典全书或预测有效。

heluo.line_conditions: judge.line_conditions逐先后天实际元堂计算二五位、众宗及主本阴元堂阳应爻有援式。source_youyuan分别给出同阶段实际应位、阴阳和clause_match；按主本阴爻读法，不以偶数爻位代替，别本阴位字面保留。yuanTang.youYing仅先天通用阴阳相异，反向相应不能称该原句命中；未中不推出无援、现实孤立或十体总评。位序偏好不是评分，dangWei仅旧位序阴阳别名；source_dangwei.match=null，阴月未定不以至点半年补定义。可用line_conditions视图读取。
heluo.evidence: 按实际chart元堂读取numerology_evidence的轨迹、条文、来源和未决规则；judge.xie仅基础命中，不能选定葉者或不葉者分支。
heluo.known_inputs: 出生时间与性别须明确提供；空白时间不能补零点。时间字段是当地钟时，时区放zone；显式零点有效。真太阳时默认开启，须明确lon或gps_lon；GPS优先，0度有效。缺失不可套上海或0度，不为通过调用自动改为钟表时。
heluo.birth_clock: numerology_evidence.birth_clock保存同次民用时刻、UTC瞬间、所选计算钟面、经度来源与是否使用。钟表时未给经度为null；太阳钟面不是新的物理瞬间。可用birth_clock视图读取。
heluo.body_structure: body_structure视图按逐阶段实际六爻返回渐卦段的八条结构记录，区分三爻倒序、上下互体、全卦倒序及抽第三爻移顶。八条含六个三爻体及两个六爻卦，不是八个互体；literal_case_match为false时只是明确算子推演，不能称该卦原例已核。五命干支字表不自动选柱或用年纳音替代。此层不替换deTi或后天换卦，不直接裁定葉否。
heluo.body_relations: judge.deTi按年柱纳音与先后天实际上下体、两互体分列五行关系，完整present=null。旧日干查卦位于judge.day_stem_mapping，不再称为得体。第51页generating_qi必须同时满足无元气且卦体生纳音；第87页双向相生另列，不能反向覆盖。金人、土人口径及完整得体、合理仍待核。
heluo.qi_phases: judge.qi_phases分别给出先后天正反元气、化工的上下体／互体位置及得失；旧聚合字段仅为并集。反化工春分至夏至按所核两版本同时保留离、巽。土用约定、乙亥例乾化工冲突与气虚制化仍待核；命中不自动裁定葉否或现实吉凶。 yuanqi_opposition按出生年干支核对正反候选，再逐阶段计算无正而有反前提；正反同时出现不匹配该式。上下体／两互体为具名范围，direct_only_condition_match只作另一范围的比较；不能借另一阶段的元气补本阶段。rescue_match为null，节气浅深、气虚和尅制未定，不据此自动裁定反中有救或葉否。 solar_term.boundary_context按原民用年选共享节气窗口，保存当前节气、最近至点及下一四立的真实来源和绝对时刻，并与calendar_context核对。二数时令也用同一民用年上下文；相邻年求根不授权越界公开年份。TT参考与历史／未来UTC、原典日期桥接分开，不能因来源字段或数值分辨率就称全历法已验。
heluo.najia: judge.najia逐阶段列出实际六爻正纳、借用、出生年干支命中位置和source。basis=hexagram_entry表示该卦条目已核；pure_trigram_rule仅按已核纯卦内外位推演，不能说该复卦已逐爻原页核对。najia_collation区分8个纯卦48/12基础位置与13条卦解78/18观察；其余51卦未逐卦核，64卦384位置的软件比对不是384个原典命例。解卦source_issues保留两印本列举次序问题，不改计算爻序或以纳甲命中断完整得势。可用najia视图读取。
heluo.month_affinity: judge.deTime仅卦属月匹配；64卦总论目校含63项明确属月，无妄本月仍未确认。judge.month_affinity区分离散月份、跨年区间、季节、及时和失时；month_label_match仅月号，附加条件未决时即使月号未中也保持match=null。十三条原句的natal_najia_clause分别列月号和同一先／后天阶段出生年干支的正纳／借用位置；不可借另一阶段或deSheng合并布尔替代。及字连接范围与解卦例外未决，两项事实均不裁成整条吉凶。乾八月与颐九月边界为null；随正月相反条件同时保留，不选有利段覆盖。月界与完整得体仍待核。
heluo.seasonal_numbers: judge.seasonal_numbers分别给出正数比较、至弱太过、十一数式及六个时令窗口。重叠全部保留；numeric_band_match只判断绝对数段，得中为null未量化，不能把25/30或不在窗口推成综合吉凶。
heluo.timing: heluo_timing按影印页规则给出流年、月卦与日卦定式；analysis_year为年标签，month_index/day_index为原典序号，不能当公历年月日或精确应期；不指定年时不自动取当前年。
heluo.validation: 原典部分核验、语料未全量校勘、现实预测未验证；周易参照不替代河洛注文。
heluo.text_collation: 乾坤屯蒙需讼师比小畜履六十条注文单次目校，commentary_sections按原文分段但applicability=null；旧文另存inherited_detail。不能借judge.xie选葉否或把歲運段用作本命断语；龍妾、掌無權、正即、無舊、女人為女人等本印本文字保留，初读撤回不计作继承错录。师六三commentary_cross_references仅核有条件引升三的单爻变，applicability=null且不改后天盘；比六二不混入全卦纳甲条件，该条件仍在month_affinity与najia。小畜九三未另印不葉者，实际三段与condition_labels_not_separately_printed不表示条件false；葉者段不等于吉类。小畜初引巽初与正式后天巽四同卦异爻，不能换爻辞；履上變為引兌不自动换卦。字兆和數凶者等嵌套条件未求值，不映射现代姓名或现实结果。诗歌不见于已核的这些爻解段落，来源待核，旧verdict摘要标签未获底本认证。标题与注文各有载入字节sha256和锁定该版文字／标签／元数据的content_sha256；JSON排版变化可以保留内容身份，但换正文或交换分支不得沿用已校身份。内容身份不证明读法、全书符合或预测有效。来源缺失／损坏是不可重试内部来源故障，不归咎用户出生参数。
heluo.yuantang: 用yuantang视图核对chart.yuantang_derivation的实际性别、时组、逐位序列、至点半年和换卦。counterfactuals仅比较阴阳令敏感性，实际选择以half_year.value为准；不能据反事实改算出生盘。half_year.value或heLi为null时不补成阴令或异类。公开日期工具按出生绝对瞬间确定半年，不用整个子月或午月猜。
heluo.pillar_links: pillar_links视图核numerology_evidence.pillar_links的实际年柱起月干、所用日柱起时干、原句起头与顺行步数。立春前不用公历年干，晚子及太阳钟跨日不用未换日日干替代。干序衔接匹配不证明原典月界、日界、历史钟制或全历法准确；原书个别形式算例含衔接冲突，不能据数算可复现当真实出生盘。
heluo.source_clock: 岁运year_context绑定实际cycleYear与出生年柱，不能拿公历出生年或另一干支年替代。source_clock列卷一百刻式：寅申巳亥各九刻，其余八刻。时支循环原点及一刻七分的分制未由所核段确立；等长时辰假设推得18分一刻只是数式相合条件，不能选它凑原典符合。physical_clock_applied与calendar_mapping_complete均false；不可把源刻序换成当前出生钟面、实际日卦日期或预测应期。 六日进一支的branch_shift_projection保留八／九刻不等长，六十块总365源日是支初相对推演；不用选18分制，仍不解决日内添分、任意刻内转移或节月实日。 jiehou_evidence把节卦与候卦分开：按本次节气名选四正卦爻，现代节气间隔不用15／90日替代。原列72标签有爻名差异；连续爻序与首卦轮满六日两种具名模型分别对照原例及节候表，吻合程度不同而不暗选。原印、卦形、推演分别解释，selected_hou及huagong_assessment保持null，不推出实际日卦或吉凶。

canping.method: 默认gu用真实日支，ming为显式月支变法；二者规则来源与结果分别说明。
canping.known_inputs: 出生时间与性别须明确提供；空白时间不能补零点。时间字段是当地钟时，时区放zone；显式零点有效。真太阳时默认开启，须明确lon或gps_lon；GPS优先，0度有效。缺失不可套上海或0度，不为通过调用自动改为钟表时。
canping.birth_clock: numerology_evidence.birth_clock保存同次民用时刻、UTC瞬间、所选计算钟面、经度来源与是否使用。钟表时未给经度为null；太阳钟面不是新的物理瞬间。可用birth_clock视图读取。
canping.timing: dayun_method默认bazi_appendix_v1为卷七整数借除，continuous为现代连续折算，legacy为未核旧命宫排法。配运先读timing_policy视图：schedule_basis逐原句标applied_rule／对照，区分所选附法、另书十年背景和现代落点约定；first_row为同次实际首行，旧法保留年龄标签和取文；first_period仅为已映射日期首运摘要，旧法为null，两者均非查询当段。查询读selected，未起运不取首运代替；全运再取periods，完整立春用calendar_boundaries。
canping.evidence: 按年纳音部、顺逆编号与实际男女或岁运条文解释，缺条和缺字只表示语料缺口。
canping.validation: 本命起数有限核对通过不代表起运大运体系或现实预测已经验证。
canping.text_selection: 按benming或实际查询当段verses的selectionShun/selectionNi读五行、编号和上男／中女／下共用岁运栏，不能串栏。pair_resolution区分顺逆同号与两号、单向有文；原书允许顺有逆无或逆有顺无，本地缺行不等于原典圈空，也不能断现实灾祸。1123格经首次目校及同一审阅者原图复读确定；水、火、木、金、土各234格全段目读，其中分别10、11、13、11、2格未决；全表1170格均已目读，47格未决不计入已确定数；目读覆盖不等于读法全部确认、原典全书符合或独立复核完成；火2743、2248及木2816、2917、3315、2424编号经原图复查仍有印章遮盖或首位淡损，暂按继承键定位，number_attribution_status=provisional_inherited_key，三栏均保留未定，正文或圈空可辨不代表号文归属已核；number_reading_evidence保留原图编号片段和unresolved状态，body_reading_status仅分列此前字面正文可读／全圈空／局部圈空／编辑疑读，body_evidence_basis说明非本轮新校正文；14格正文可读不增加已确定数，六行十八格整体仍source_reading_uncertain；part_coverage分部列明覆盖，仍待独立复核。 reading_revision保留原图复读前疑读，rereading_witness记录同馆藏IIIF原图区域；additional_rereading_witnesses另存后续各批，水部旧见证不被覆盖；土部三格复读一格确定、两格仍未定；3377女文晝字形不代表词义已定，晝亦可作畫异体。3379原有檠／晝文字保持，拟改撤回，不生成虚假修订或新增确认数；金部15格旧疑读复读4格确定、11格仍未定，保留麴蘖／追遊世；3314时运只明花字且仍带□，不得抄同号女文或计为整格已核，金部末十一条号文归属问题与字形校勘分开；木部四格旧疑读复读三格确定、一格仍未定，保留撫手／玉藍／門帳字面；2519只补明傾而后一字□不补，不将部分改读计为整格已核；火部11格旧疑读复读六格确定、五格仍未定，旧鴛□改蒼鷹、浩雲按原图保留，暗字可辨但末字仍□不升级，不依熟语改文；水部旧40格疑读经复读30格确定、10格仍未决，新增编号格、独立审阅者、命例和历法时刻均为0，不按典故补字。金部末十一行按所选底本原页号文归属取条，继承同号旧文保留，计算编号不重映射；差异原因及继承语料来源未明，不泛称所有版本错排。○为原页圈空，□为编辑未定；不得按典故补字；2869附诗编号与公式不合、适用未明，未作为通用补文。 所选格的witnesses为文明书局本局部对读，主选文仍为textShun/Ni；不得按吉凶择本、串栏或以对读文补主本○/□。different_text只指字符串不同，未自动裁定版本异文或错字；同一审阅者对读不算独立复核，主本1123格校勘数不随对读36格增加。
canping.pillar_links: pillar_links视图核numerology_evidence.pillar_links的实际年柱起月干、所用日柱起时干、原句起头与顺行步数。立春前不用公历年干，晚子及太阳钟跨日不用未换日日干替代。干序衔接匹配不证明原典月界、日界、历史钟制或全历法准确；原书个别形式算例含衔接冲突，不能据数算可复现当真实出生盘。

taiyi.scope: calculation_mode支持year/month/day/hour，默认year。月计按所选节月起元，日计按金钥匙冬至前甲子积日，时计按所选至点或完整积时配置；核对实际calendar_rules及配置，现代天文与钟面适配不等于完整古历复原。玄命未实现。
taiyi.evidence: 按本次taiyi.calendar_rules确认岁首，再读取core_board、rule_trace、patterns、ruleset；未命中空间关系不能推成吉凶，原典分歧不隐去。
taiyi.efficacy: 现实预测效力未检验；数值不是概率，独立转录案例也不证明现实效力。
taiyi.annual_cycles: 年计long_cycles分别用卷五积年：三基285011、五福/大游13331、小游/四神等3361，均锚724年；直符原表与正文不一致时同时展示，不用八将积数或现代地区替换原典分野。
taiyi.conditions: 五将/门具问题读取conditions视图（合参taiyi_conditions）；全部阻断按同次patterns路径解释。年/月计以实际门盘合取；时计三门未评估/null不能改成满足。即使两层满足也不推出实际成败。
taiyi.gates: 年/月按预先所选王法核三门；李法四盘及定计目门盘另列比较。默认至点时计的门盘/定计仍未算；明确选key_hour_winter_jiazi_v1可算完整积时、时支合神、定计和阴阳四门，但三门主体未决仍为null。各配置不按结果择优，不借奇门门盘补齐。
taiyi.hour_profiles: hour_profile仅用于hour；默认jinjing_hour_solstice_v1是现代至点置一。key_hour_winter_jiazi_v1按金钥匙冬至前甲子连续积时，calendar_rules.hour_origin保存同盘日期、完整积时和现代23时子初约定。合参放在taiyi_options。不可把只求太乙宫的甲己捷数代替完整积时，也不宣称古历复原。
taiyi.daily: calculation_mode=day明确选金钥匙冬至前甲子积日；合参置taiyi_options。按所选钟面零时换日，不乘十二；同日甲子纳入是现代约定，不能套用时计720时相位不变。日计专用daily_calendar/daily_essences视图需先设day，保留十精未知、正文与课式异数，全年十神不当作十精。 天时按十二支通则计算，有年度第10数亥及金镜/统宗补证；日44例坤与实际酉并列为差异，不能将源文坤写成实际计算值。太乙数只给局序，四宫语义仍未知。
taiyi.paged_first_view: 先核对result_delivery.deferred_fields：若仅run_metadata.runtime延后，业务依据已内联，可据所选字段解读，环境复核再读取同run完整runtime。若业务字段延后，须沿first_page_uri/next_uri读回同run投影载荷并核对sha256后解释该字段；不能当作不存在或重算全文替代。
taiyi.historical_dates: 输入日期统一为推算公历；儒略历日期须先明确转换。calendar_rules.historical_date_reference只对选定金钥匙课例返回独立历表日期、原积数及实际积数，逐项核对匹配，不代表完整古历、全盘原典符合或应验。固定现代时区及代表钟面须明示，不能把未知古例时地补造成事实。
taiyi.monthly: 仅month可选month_profile。省略保留金镜六纪节月；key_month_tianzheng_jie_v1按金钥匙完年乘十二、加天地二正与本月名义序，仍按现代节月边界。full积月及1504截数分别返回，不先约360求240门周。KEY直门加定计目，原门段684/184/死4与本盘原例相位695/215/惊5并列，三门主体未裁定。独立历表若显示农历月与节月不符须明示，不按吉凶改选方法。 独立历表的朔月比较是一项假设；source_calendar_basis=not_adjudicated时，不能声称原书已证实采用朔月。
taiyi.enclosures: 提挟读取enclosures（合参taiyi_enclosures）：李法太乙与一将夹正宫、同方大小二将短弧夹太乙或对方目将分层。间神按原位读取，不并八门扇区，几何命中不认证完整挟闭。pattern_paths指向同盘各自记录；二将完整记录在enclosure_assessment.two_general_enclosure.patterns，旧全局patterns保持；完整挟闭、四郭固杜未评估，未命中不代替不存在，不套用现实胜负断语。
taiyi.historical_year: year_profile仅用于year：jinjing_year_historical_table_v1选381—385晋历主表；jinjing_year_qiliang_table_v1选501—505齐梁史历表，保留502闰四月及未决闰五月／六月候选。两者各62个月1831日、范围外拒绝；默认现代农历保持，不自动按日期选配置。historical_year_calendar视图保留同次日期、原儒略历与推算公历、作者版本及未裁定范围；历表不是王氏同元古历或其他两术古历，年栏不裁定逐日改元。
taiyi.count_sources: 核count_source_assessment时分开当前二目/算数、所选原表字面、书影校读和源位置重算。三者不互相覆盖；两算相符不认证目位或全盘相符，原表差异仍未裁定。适用于年/月/日/时计循环核心。
taiyi.elemental_relations: 读取elemental_guan_assessment以核二目纳音所选十六神五行片段。天目/地目按原文语境与文昌主、始击客对应，不套六十甲子日柱纳音；空间关和五将合取不由本项覆盖。
taiyi.year_calendar: 年计核对year_calendar视图（合参taiyi_year_calendar）：civil_lunar_calendar保留输入钟表日期实际换算的年月日及本次来源；historical_calendar保留明确所选历史历表。analysis_context.lunar_display仅为校正钟面上下文，真太阳时跨日时不能替代年计日期。未单列conversion_source不补造逐日权威认证；岁首工程约定与原典裁定仍分开。
taiyi.civil_clock: 独立太乙可选analysis_utc_offset与analysis_timezone联合核对明确民用偏移，保留命名时区并选择回拨中的一次；缺失仍拒绝重复钟时，跳时/整日缺口或不符偏移不回退。clock_basis视图保留calendar_rules/summary的civil_clock_resolution及真实UTC、fold、运行时区规则指纹。真太阳钟只是计算标签，不能再当民用钟排除。三式已有time含ISO偏移表示实际瞬间再转zone，语义与联合钟表标签核对不同。

sanshiunited.scope: 按synthesis.time_scopes解释年/月/日/时计；palace_correspondences按真实方位联接五将与星门神，太乙宫数不可直接套奇门宫数。
sanshiunited.options: taiyi_options只接受calculation_mode=year/month/day/hour及对应year_profile/month_profile/hour_profile；阴阳遁和布盘方向由实际计法与日期计算。
sanshiunited.interpretation: 三式共用输入与历法，不能当三份独立证据；未定义统一事件规则，不输出综合胜率。
sanshiunited.sources: 首读source_profiles保留实际规则版本、作者、原典链接及未决条数；完整未决内容按source_path回原盘rulesets/ruleset读取，摘要不表示已全书验收。
sanshiunited.conditions: 五将/门具问题读取conditions视图（合参taiyi_conditions）；全部阻断按同次patterns路径解释。年/月计以实际门盘合取；时计三门未评估/null不能改成满足。即使两层满足也不推出实际成败。

sanshiunited.qimen_stem_scope: 合参首读保留日/时取用、甲日是否自动替代和来源。岁干、月朔、时干支入墓细节仍在同盘qimen.stem_context，按主题续读；首读未选这些字段不等于格局不存在。
sanshiunited.qimen_profiles: 首读保留已选八神、九星旺相、三奇入墓配置的id、书名、来源及异文说明；具体顺序、旺相映射和未采用候选按同次qimen.rule_profiles续读。配置说明不能代替实际宫位事实，未读取不视为不存在。

sanshiunited.god_yin_scope: 类神阴神按实际天将所乘支再查上神，天乙依所选昼夜表互取；与四课第二、四课的阴神称谓分层。年命上神缺项保留未知，季节本空事实不替代有效空亡及日辰德合相生，综合类神可用性仍未裁。金口诀附带六壬盘的本层不替代金口诀四位取用。

otherbu.input: planet/sign/house必须是本次实际骰面；实际第N宫传house=N-1。中文、英文和符号可直接传入；缺项追问，不猜测或抽取替代结果。
otherbu.context: 仅骰面解读省略date/time/zone/经纬度；若请求独立天象背景，完整传入实际资料。tradition/hsys/zodiacal仅作用于天象背景，不改变骰面。天象背景按astronomical_context视图选择fields，分页时读回同run完整投影结果。保留ephemerisReferencePoints中的系统质心、本体中心、近似及未确认参考点，不将质心写成本体中心。
otherbu.interpretation: 以symbolic_details和rule_trace为依据，保留rulesets版本和来源。区分自定位与未给出的其他定位星；喜乐宫是宫号关系，不是星座尊贵或成功概率。diceChart为假设整宫示意，无真实度数、相位或ASC/MC；不得从天象背景补写骰面定位星、互容或应期。
otherbu.validation: 星座条件只覆盖指定原典的部分关系；外行星/交点不套七曜尊贵。validation.prediction=not_validated，不把解释或规则关系换算成功概率。
otherbu.longitude_motion: 天象背景的十个物理天体按实际热带或Lahiri黄道读取chart.params.chart_profile.longitude_motion与chart.chart.objects[].motion。保留native_longitude_speed及修正分项，method_id来自实际求导记录；Moshier完整视位置求导不改变解析轨道，未收敛明确不应用。Lahiri包含所选零点的运动，不能复制热带速度。月亮未采用独立光行时分项不表示完整位置求导未执行；分项与整体状态分别核对。这些速度不能证明精确驻留时刻、原典整例或现实预测。

fengshui_assess.surface_frame: 以坐着使用的桌沿为近沿near，远离坐者的桌沿为far；这是桌面坐标，不是房间前后或罗盘方向
fengshui_assess.item_fields: object_id,label,representation,observation_basis,evidence必填；zone与zone_observation_basis成对可选，属性确认与位置确认分别保存；只确认左右不能补近远，照片位置为image_observed
fengshui_assess.feasibility: feasible_zones只含用户逐区明确确认能容纳对象并保持视野的区域，不从照片空白、物件属性确认或允许移动扩展；其余省略
fengshui_assess.birth_choice: birth_date、birth_at、effective_birth_year最多传一个，不能同时传日期和时刻
fengshui_assess.scene_selection: 工位scene=workstation，合租scene=shared_rental，家居scene=home；自动按事实展开飞星、金锁、八宅，局部前两法优先，显式methods优先。不为优先级补年份或宅运；年盘不替代历史宅盘。独立形态/桌面/context不要求生辰或罗盘。无场景无作者无context保留原三法默认。场景首轮fields按需追加method_policy；细节参考按需读method_details。 method_policy.priority_review_status/missing与已选计算状态独立；available_engine_layers仅现状已完整计算层，候选读priority_review_by_scope.candidates及available_candidate_engine_layers，不以候选代替现状。priority_missing_inputs为可选审查索引，不是待传参数或必追问清单。
fengshui_assess.layout_planning: 家具动作放layout_constraints；候选放layout_alternatives，声明changes并独立提供新位置placement/form_observation，许可和physically_feasible各自确认。候选fields追加layout_analysis.alternatives_analysis；ready表示可执行门槛，不表示各方法均有利或现实效力。 候选features仅提供同一候选对象在新位置独立确认的金锁砂水方向/分类/依据；与新placement落宫一致。旧对象已有features而候选缺少新features时保持待确认，其他固定环境可保留。读取候选environment_adjustments及rule_comparisons，不复用旧目标砂水。 候选environmental_context不得改变非目标固定对象的楼层/坐标系；省略固定砂水仍保留原floor元数据。逐规则比较包含所选飞星原始参考，comparison_scope不表示完整组合吉凶；layer_statuses列候选真实计算状态。 镜等环境物件可仅给候选environmental_context的相关双对象interior_relations，不伪造门床桌灶placement。原关系任一端移动都重核同kind及两端，静态端已知楼层保留；改变空间归属必须changes含location。材质/器形/颜色/存活状态及代表物用途不能借搬转改写，照片或未知可独立确认。
fengshui_assess.natal_interpretation: 玄空有限解释需 xuankong.interpretation 显式启用 xuankong_conditioned_v1；当前评价运 current_period_number 与 period_evidence 成对，不改历史宅运。external_forms 按全宅中心八宫独立确认外部山形/水形，未知省略，照片保留候选，不复用金锁砂水或室内靠背；床/门取用结合顶层 placements.location_direction，桌/灶未覆盖。fields 追加 layout_analysis.natal_interpretation；仅有限五行与当令形势条件，不是完整81组合吉凶或可立即搬动建议。
fengshui_assess.environmental_context: environmental_context提供独立环境/家庭/楼层事实，不传八字紫微喜忌；首轮fields追加layout_analysis.environmental_context。orientation分别确认direction_confirmed、north_reference、floorplan_alignment_confirmed、center_confirmed；未确认落宫不能同时传位置/砂水/外局分宫，仍可原始盘与独立形态。household_members按辈分/本家庭排行，household_composition_confirmed确认成员范围，配偶排行须显式声明。objects定义厨卫/绿化/器物而不改名为门床桌灶；floors保存实际使用人/对象，院落level=1，floor_influences区分本层与共同作用；异层适宜须成对依据。无注册规则的厨卫/材质器形保持未覆盖，拱门/开放厨房仅低优先提醒。 household_scope=symbolic_reference仅解释卦名/对宫，不追罗盘、不绑定实地方区；此选择不免除同时请求的楼层方位要求。家庭索引仅飞星/金锁适用，非八宅命卦。subject_ids仅正向使用事实；负向排除需有关楼层/院落usage_confirmed=true并配usage_evidence，且名单覆盖其对象显式使用人。
fengshui_assess.interior_relations: 明确非罗盘关系用environmental_context.interior_relations：relation_id/source_object_id/target_object_id/kind/present/observation_basis/evidence；present必须显式true、false或null，照片true/false均候选，不由相邻/可见推直接相对。objects.role独立确认主门、厕门、镜、梁管、厕墙、尖角源，床桌灶可继承明确purpose；床柱角仅pillar_corner，不外推普通家具角。仅相关输入时fields追加layout_analysis.interior_analysis。Joey/CYFS/WOFS各作者版本独立，镜照床保留BTB异议；各动作绑定实际对象与操作权限，允许仍须新位置和物理可行确认，不作现实健康财富预测。
fengshui_assess.material_facts: 材料器形用environmental_context.material_facts：fact_id/object_id/material?/shape?/colour?/plant_alive?/observation_basis/evidence；至少一属性，未知用unknown，属性按独立证据粒度保存。element_use只明确询问wood_remedy等代表物资格，不是个人喜用或房屋所需元素。AFSI材料/颜色与FSI器形参考分开；processed_wood不作AFSI木材料，明确绿色可另列颜色替代；镜面/尖角还核实际几何。仅相关输入时fields追加layout_analysis.material_analysis；资格不认证摆位或可执行动作。
fengshui_assess.method_reference: 纯方法/职业家具参考可用scene=home作通用家居参考查询标签，analyze_layout=false，按问题显式methods并投影method_details；年度对照仅加实际effective_year或确认的query_at。无真实环境事实时省略environmental_context，不提交空对象或仅household_scope。scene不生成房屋/房间/观察/摆位结论；household_scope=symbolic_reference只用于已给household_members的家庭象意，不等于通用reference_only。
fengshui_assess.interpretation: 先解释已有依据，再给条件式建议；照片候选不升级事实，但不等待全部complete或动作ready才解释。analysis_progress.interpretation_status区分available/conditional/scope_only/insufficient_evidence；follow_up.conclusion_candidates只择会改变当前所问结论的缺项追问，execution_only仅用于落实动作。未实现或无规则直接说明，不反复索取资料；计算定宫与宅运校验保留，边界简述一次。
fengshui_assess.workstation_review: 工位工作/学习用途用 environmental_context.workstation_review.activities，逐项显式选 workstation_activity_authored_v1 并给实际活动/证据；按 placements.location_direction 读取各候选宅盘向星，位置与朝向分开，不要求外部有水或桌上放水。评价运可用该review.evaluation_period独立确认，不以日期/宅运代替。入口隔挡用 entry_barriers 显式 afsi_entry_barrier_v1，分别登记实际入口/桌/隔挡、两端直线与隔挡介入观察及 operation；执行许可和通行/视野/操作/容纳独立。fields追加layout_analysis.workstation_analysis，rulesets/rule_trace保留。WOFS桌面只作reference_only，不开启固定吉位。
fengshui_assess.material_application: material_facts.application显式选afsi_application_conditions_v1；有明确element_use才核相应水体清洁/流动、金属暴露/定性尺度或植物健康，各条件用value/observation_basis/evidence独立证据。target_request_id可引用本轮element_adjustments.request_id，只有实际算出的introduced_element才可绑定；资格、条件、目标绑定、实际位置、剂量和效力分开，不因条件确认返回ready。摆位候选须重核已有application的条件和目标，不能换目标或漏旧属性。
fengshui_assess.workstation_measured: 有实际尺寸的人工标注用workstation_layout.scene；+y图纸前方、桌面+x右/+y远沿，米制尺寸/高度/眼高/头顶高分别明确。compass独立提供北基准、角误差、参考中心和chart_binding_confirmed，sector_anchor明确坐者或桌中心；不自动立极。照片/坐标误差保持候选，清单不完整时未列观察仍未知。search提供完整有限位置/角度域，复用layout_constraints搬转许可；实测同一对象不重复提交placements/form_observations/features或旧关系。fields按需追加layout_analysis.workstation_layout_analysis；保留全部search.receipts、拒绝与未显示前沿数量，不把ready或Pareto集合解释为风水总分。BTB与wofs_desktop_compass_v1须逐个明确另选；植物身份、状态及几何分别核对，向星不等于坐向或桌面水体需求。 搜索域可用positions或grid二选一；grid明确原点和步长，默认从房间/桌面生成中心候选。竖直屏幕可在items[].screen实测，检查整面透视遮挡，required_visible明确是否硬约束，不推断眩光。算法完工审查读取research_completion_status/research_coverage；请求complete不代表完整81或24山已完成。

western_timing_analysis.target_clock: analysis_hour/minute 是目标钟时，按 birth_timezone；显式0有效。省略分别沿用出生小时/分钟，仅兼容日期级调用。return_timezone转换同一时刻。
western_timing_analysis.delivery: MCP默认8192字符，完整结果超限返回result_delivery。用其manifest_uri按所需字段或分页读取同一run；完整JSON重组核对sha256，不重新计算，不解析截断片段。
western_timing_analysis.complete_export: 用户要求完整JSON、全部时间线或完整文件时，首次fields=null，保留默认响应预算，再读取result_delivery；first_view仅用于摘要咨询，不能先投影摘要再补算全文。
western_timing_analysis.evidence: 首次按问题选择evidence_views.stage/annual/short_term/career的fields；事业兼阶段与目标时段用career，结合本命职业配置筛选相关hits。默认与其他视图不强制展开全部方法；fields=null仍表示全量。

ziwei_horoscope.projection: 普通摘要显式使用 suggested_fields；strict_fields=true 配合 fields=null 仍是全量，不会自动精简。
ziwei_horoscope.scopes: scopes数组只能整体投影；按本轮粒度解释所需层，不编造scopes.流年或数字索引路径，不默认读取snapshot_export。
ziwei_horoscope.identity: analysis_context是目标时刻，birth_context是出生回执；scopes.palace_name/natal_palace_name表示运限命宫所临本命宫。其他本层功能宫读取palace_map.scope_palace_name；mutagen_natal_links分别标记natal_palace_name与scope_palace_name，不混淆为同一功能宫。仅功能名旋宫，未包含全部流曜、飞宫体系或事件结论。
ziwei_horoscope.target_clock: target_minute默认0，target_timezone默认Asia/Shanghai，与出生时区独立；目标时刻采用钟表时间。分钟输入不证明分钟级预测。
ziwei_horoscope.rules: 本命和运限使用同一rule_profile/version。iztro_2_5_8 1.1.2保留已起限的软件规则；quanshu_v2_excerpt 1.3.2选择闰月、四化、亮度、长生、旬空双支、部分流年星，并采用邻宫起大限和火铃年支定点读法。source_rules视图核对实际差异，岁首、小限年龄基准、闰月斗君和后续流月日时未据此认证；动态四化复用选表仍是软件约定。
ziwei_horoscope.flowing_stars: 流年软件配置返回禄羊陀三项；摘录配置再返回天德、月德、丧门、吊客、白虎、官府，共九项，保留system_id与两种宫位身份。annual_three_sha只给原文明示三支集合，individual_name_positions=null时不自行给奏书/将军/直符逐一配宫，也不借博士同名星填补。
ziwei_horoscope.childhood: childhood视图单列明文一至六岁童限及实际本命星曜。岁序仍按已披露软件规则；后续岁序未唯一解释时留空，不把本命mutagen当童限四化，也不拿童限证明起大限前替代关系。
ziwei_horoscope.time_input: 首轮回执time_input_status标记实际校时状态；time_input视图给出原校时过程、时区来源和地点精度。默认缺经度降级、省级代表点或仅按经度假设时区均按实际条件说明；不能把没有计算的均时差当0，也不把派生秒数当出生资料秒精度。 minute_sensitivity只比较给定钟表分钟内秒0和59.999999的假设端点；跨时辰或排盘日期时首轮上下文有time_input_minute_sensitive=true。不得替换原命盘、猜实际出生秒数、将端点当两份出生事实，或把样本误差当全局精度界。
ziwei_horoscope.pre_decade: 大限status=not_started表示按所选五行局起岁尚未开始；宫位、宫干、四化为null，palace_map及mutagen_natal_links为空。六层索引保留但该层未计算，不把童限或其本命星曜当大限／童限四化。其他五层照实际结果解释；岁首仍未获原典认证。
ziwei_horoscope.sihua_source: sihua_source=rule_profile沿用基础配置；仅在明确指定明刊四化时选naj_ming_v1。三工具同选项，组合版本含+sihua.naj-ming-v1，sihua_source_url专指四化，classical_source仍是基础配置来源。庚日武同相会实际改本命标记及各层按干查表；不因此更改安星、亮度、岁序，也不认证古典运限复用或整书。
ziwei_horoscope.civil_offset: birth_utc_offset与target_utc_offset分别核对出生和目标命名时区，并选择重复钟时；先后按UTC瞬间比较。偏移选择与nominal_age_basis分别记录，不能把太阳标签当成另一实际瞬间。
ziwei_horoscope.limit_subperiods: 明刊运限分段首次按需展开limit_subperiods或limit_subperiod_details的fields；视图名不是参数。大限上/下五年依既有虚岁与实际所临十岁区间，不能用年龄末位取余。它不认证原典岁首或星曜应验几何；natal_star_groups只给原文分类与实际本命星对象，南北斗双属仍无唯一分段，小限半年起止未定，不补公历7月1日或农历七月。原文为福邻句未计算，不能只筛吉星；不变更四化、星位或给出事件断言。详尽首调选完整字段，再沿该run分页；索引run不能读回未请求的明细。
ziwei_horoscope.calendar_sources: calendar核时钟与日期，calendar_sources核date_conversion_provenance：lookups逐个连接实际日期、实施provider与印刷参照，implementation_sources保存所用补表原出处。1900参照TAM全年表，最初30日用PMO补表；1901—2100参照HKO，2100年2月9日后使用HKO补表。实施数据不是独立验证，既有历法数值及混合时钟岁序未借来源标记改写。长结果按首次所选fields沿同run分页取齐。 普通日期的实施者是fatebridge_lunardate_adapter_v1，包含上游库表与本系统已登记修正；逐时钟核applied_year_info_correction，按实际农历年取1933/1954/1978等登记，不按公历年份代选。编码是实施证据，不是新的独立历法观测或置信分。
ziwei_horoscope.nominal_age_basis: 岁序默认birth_civil_timezone：两端实际瞬间均换算到出生民用时区，以该区民用日期查农历年，正月初一00:00换岁。先读nominal_age_calendar核对两端年份、方法、参考区及与legacy_mixed_clock的差值；出生安星仍用原排盘钟，流年/月/日/时仍用目标钟，不混称同一历日。legacy_mixed_clock仅显式回放旧算法，旧春节边界仍可能报错。该修复解决混合时钟岁序的一致性，不认证原典岁首或现实预测。 旧公式比较值不是另一份旧口径成功回执。读取legacy_mixed_clock_age时同时核对legacy_comparison_applied、legacy_comparison_is_separate_run和legacy_ordinal_status：默认比较未应用、未另运行；0值标为would_reject_below_one，显式旧口径会拒算。ordinal_at_least_one只核公式下限，不保证完整旧运行成功，不能把比较值0说成旧回执返回0岁。
ziwei_horoscope.natal_prerequisites: 问起岁、五行局或本命前置推导时，按natal_prerequisites视图首次请求相应fields；完整JSON仍fields=null。natal_prerequisites直接携带本次运限内部已算本命的lunar_date/year_stem/hour_branch/ming_gong/shen_gong/wuxing_ju及三个原rule_trace，separate_birth_run=false，不是另一次ziwei_birth回执。按实际月时→命身→年干和命宫干支→纳音元素/局数说明连接；源文比较仍以给定农历条件为前提，不认证日期转换、甲人语义或古典岁首。出生排盘钟与nominal_age_calendar参考钟、目标流曜钟可不同，不能用计岁或目标年干覆盖此处本命年干；nayin字符串是实算纳音，原文名目比较未做时不能说该名字已校勘。

firdaria.scope: 普通人生阶段问题的正常候选，窄查只用本工具，不默认运行全部西占时运。
firdaria.field_root: 单项读 firdaria.current_major/current_sub；聚合读 time_lords.firdaria.current_major/current_sub，不复制前缀。
firdaria.time: 保留实际主运／分运起止、夜盘顺序和年长口径；阶段切换不等于现实事件日期。

bazi_health.scope: 仅盘内文化分类与传统对应，不是中医体质辨识、辨证或医学评估。
bazi_health.scope_limits: 只解释盘内分类、传统对应与关系变化，不推疾病风险，不据喜用开调理处方。
bazi_health.depth: evidence_chain按星位、根气与条件取证；structure_checks只审有限前提，formation_status=not_adjudicated不能解释成已成格。topic.timing使用实际生效柱，不是全年扫描；未知性别保留传统选星分支。

astro_relative_chart.views: 首次按已选 relative_mode 取 evidence_views 对应 fields；suggested_fields 是未选专用视图时的安全联合，不要求每次读取全部分支。核对实际 relationship_profile.relative_mode_normalized/primary_layer。
astro_relative_chart.mode_aliases: Comp→compare；Composite→composite；Synastry→influence；TimeSpace→timespace；Marks→marks；数值0..4依次对应这五种规范模式。
astro_relative_chart.delivery: 主层超预算时从 result_delivery 读取同一 run；投影后不能恢复首次未选字段。完整JSON首次 fields=null。
astro_relative_chart.marks: Marks主层为marks_chart_pair，分别读marks_charts.inner/outer；chart仅为内方别名。每盘是本人与双方Davison资料再次计算Davison，沿实际davison_variant；不使用已撤除的组合／时空盘混合算法，不把个人象征盘当双方本命、真实心意或关系成功率。compatibility来自基础跨盘自定义规则，不能称为Marks原典评分。

bazi_career.evidence: 首次按问题选evidence_views.direction/target_year；默认视图保留完整十神权重、并列与作用域，primary只作兼容首标签，不表示显著占优。
bazi_career.patterns: career_structure/entrepreneurship中的共现标签为heuristic_candidate_only；按rule_signals.trigger、unverified_conditions解释，分数及level不认证古典成格或现实能力。
bazi_career.target_clock: 日期级专项固定出生时区的本地零点，timing_context回显analysis_datetime、timezone和boundary_status；交节当日涉及钟时才按实际目标用timing_analysis补证，不以已有流年阻止必要补证。
bazi_career.depth: evidence_chain按星位、根气与条件取证；structure_checks只审有限前提，formation_status=not_adjudicated不能解释成已成格。topic.timing使用实际生效柱，不是全年扫描；未知性别保留传统选星分支。

knowledge_read.astro_aspect_scope: 星体对仅标注所查询相位的对象，必须同时指定category=aspect和aspect_degree（或可定位的key）；返回是通用相位释义，不是两颗星专属规则或新增个案计算。
knowledge_read.lookup: 不确定category/key时先读knowledge_registry的domains[].categories[]；目录根是domains/source/provenance，不是domain/categories。
knowledge_read.health_scope: 传统健康原文可以作为文化出处，不把其中病名、脏腑薄弱或调理语言应用为个人医学结论。
knowledge_read.scope: Select fields for the requested domain. Legacy astro/bazi/liureng/qimen cards retain their existing semantics. Heluo/canping references use catalogue category/key and preserve source-specific partial records, without birth inputs or personal applicability evaluation.
knowledge_read.source_fidelity: Keep citation and provenance; for Heluo/canping also read reference_only and reference_details. A reference profile role is not the actual applied role of a person: bind personal interpretation to the same-run calculation result.
knowledge_read.missing_and_uncertain: Do not fill a locally missing or unselected cell, an editorial unknown glyph or a provisional number from another column, number or edition.
knowledge_read.human_design_line_reference: domain=human_design, category=lines, key=gate.line (e.g.1.1). All384 source locators remain; consult actual registry coverage for local paraphrases pending independent review, uncurated meanings and independent semantic acceptance. Null meanings are never replaced by profile-line themes. Preserve reference_details, citation and provenance. Select any personal polarity only from the same-run actual fixing_state and donor paths; the lookup never applies a line or predicts an outcome. Preserve1.4source ambiguity,2.3permanent2–14connection condition with unknown applicability, and2.6narrow receptivity in exaltation. Conditions not recorded are not thereby absent.

knowledge_registry.lookup: 分类与键在domains[].categories[]，数组先读所属根；strict fields不能直接填domain或categories。

astro_india.scope: 读取india内独立Parashari规则；顶层西占字段仅为历史兼容参考，不能冒充印占。
astro_india.physical_conditions: D1 physical_state含度数区间、Baladi、0–60 Virupa Uchcha Bala分量、运动及Santhanam注释的太阳角距条件；核对combustion的source_layer、顺逆行、阈值和未裁定边界，不当作真实可见性或现实失能；D9/D10不套物理状态。dispositor_relationship为有方向的星体关系。
astro_india.time_scales: profile.time_scale_context区分TT、模型UT1及冻结IERS闰秒假设；过期表后的future_leap_seconds_assumed_unchanged不能解释为已知未来时间精度。
astro_india.ephemeris: ephemeris_policy=auto回显实际逐星后端；require_data_files拒绝七个物理天体的分析模型降级，包括生时抽样。后端来源不证明预测有效。 ephemeris_model_scope=physical_bodies只汇总七个物理天体及其实际赤道/所选运动帧；Rahu/Ketu见nonphysical_factor_models，平交点为swisseph_analytical_mean_node。native_node_return_flags回显的请求位不证明交点读取了物理矢量文件。physical_backend_policy=strict_jpl表示运行者强制JPL；黄经、赤道、运动力几何与支撑太阳事件均遵守，原生与运动帧共用配置锁。缺失、损坏或越界为来源错误，不默退Moshier；这些来源声明不认证原典或预测效果。
astro_india.configuration: Lahiri sidereal + whole_sign 才计算本核心。显式旧式黄道/宫制覆盖返回configuration_not_supported，不另猜分盘。
astro_india.sensitivity: None不是精确生时；只传用户确认的正负范围。
astro_india.strength: Sthana五分量用Virupa，60=1Rupa；saptavargaja_profile仅切换七分盘系数与moolatrikona作用域。默认Santhanam27逐字七盘读法；Raman30不改其余四分量，特别Drekkana第二/三段分组仍为Santhanam。需读profile，不用总量认证吉凶、能力或成功概率。
astro_india.divisions: 可选2,3,7,9,10,12,30，D1始终计算。D30不等长区段仅给星座及整宫，无唯一盘内度数；任何分盘不套物理状态。
astro_india.additional_balas: Dig用实际上升/天顶角点，不用整宫起点；自然力为固定系数。Drik按Raman113-120方向差、附加特殊值、正负四分之一，未经裁定的水星性质保留scenarios，summary=null不当零；特殊附加值可超过60，不擅自截断。读source_id、nature_context、source_disagreements及shadbala_assessment；Kala/Cheshta须各自核对条件与模型状态，不拼完整六力总量。
astro_india.temporal_balas: Kala与Cheshta均为出生时刻的本命分量，不是analysis_year/as_of的时运。Natha按视太阳过中天，Hora按日出后等长平均小时，不套西占不等时小时；日主日出换日，岁/月主为360/30日传统口径。月亮第八日窗口与盈亏读法、水星性质保留scenarios；星战金额按Raman76-77固定系数及本次前置力量条件计算，读取yuddha_bala.evidence/upstream_profile。同经、黄经零点、多星交战、缺少前置量仍为partial，保留同一分支关联，不把规则胜负当现实胜负。太阳/月亮运动力按所选Ayana/Paksha，五星默认未选择平均模型而保留null；可显式选择cheshta_model=simon1994_j2000，在1900-2050出生TT窗口计算现代长期平均模型，读取model_context，不冒充Raman1900表；不填零、不拼完整六力总分。
astro_india.lunar_nature: Raman53第八日窗口与117-118盈亏表述并不相同。nature_context.moon_readings保留差异；边界及有分歧角距保留两种传统分类，不把旧版单一盈亏标签当作者唯一结论。
astro_india.cheshta_model: 明确要求五星运动力或深度力量时，可选择simon1994_j2000：Simon1994完整平均黄经、独立几何J2000真位置、原有角度公式。模型仅在1900-2050出生TT窗口承认；analysis_year不改变本命窗口。默认unadjudicated及窗口外保留五星缺失。不是原书1900表校勘、完整六力或预测验证。
astro_india.reading_fidelity: reading_basis保留名义生时、未评估与抽样候选；不把未给误差当精确。星宿/宿足候选与分盘候选同一UTC网格，计数不是概率。主题力量calculation_context直接携带同run分支数值、约束与字段路径；computed_consensus/conditional_results/unavailable/partially_computed分开，null不一概为0或用户资料不足。不能只选高分支、自动全盘否定或宣称已完成独立文本盲审。Vimshottari敏感性对目标早于候选出生的样本显式列omitted_samples。
astro_india.physical_clock: 出生资料为民用钟时，use_true_solar_time默认false。v11起true只另报太阳钟标签，不改变记录钟时所指的物理时刻、盘面、达沙或模型出生年代窗口。读india.profile.clock_context；solar_wall_datetime无时区，不当另一出生时间，不当分析日期。不能把已知LAT/LMT记录直接当民用资料后开此开关。
astro_india.historical_clock: v12支持已明确的birth_clock_basis=civil/local_mean_solar/local_apparent_solar；日期为公历，不猜原始钟制。LMT/LAT省略birth_timezone且use_true_solar_time=false，按已确认地点取经度；birth_second/microsecond仅保留已知或转换数值精度，不证明原记录准确。读india.profile.clock_context及person_info.clock_conversion，区分原始无时区钟面与转换UTC载体。
astro_india.solar_uncertainty: 仅传用户确认的误差；太阳钟输入先换算原钟面区间两端，再取最长30秒物理UTC网格。保留clock_interval原始标签、转换端点、非对称offset及全部候选；覆盖计数非概率，不当连续区间证明。require_data_files同样检查LAT求解和端点换算的每次太阳坐标，不用最后一次成功掩盖中途降级。
astro_india.sthana_sources: Saptavargaja与Drekkana独立选源；默认Drekkana为santhanam_27_6。Raman36详细条文与例12取15，摘要105取60冲突仍保留在source_reading_conflicts；比较读法不挑最高值，也不认证完整单一原典六力。
astro_india.solar_component_scope: Kala太阳依赖分开：日主/时主读连续日出对，三分力读当前相邻昼夜端点；partial_solar_brackets只限制对应分量。读取solar_context及同run constraints，不因缺其他日落抹去已有结果，也不补假日出。网格状态计数不是概率。
astro_india.solar_event_scope: 日出／日落支撑窗口逐项检索同一UT1日界内的连续事件；不假定每天仅一个同类事件。solar_events.enumeration的1秒仅是检索防重复步长，不是出生记录或实测精度。

astro_vimshottari.clock: 公历。analysis_year给定时缺月/日各取1；完全未给日期按as_of的出生时区日期，未给钟时取00:00。出生与分析时刻的DST歧义需明确UTC偏移。
astro_vimshottari.periods: Moon-nakshatra，主运/次运从完整原始主运起算；UTC日历标签按每天86400名义秒的datetime口径，不表示连续原子时历时。三种年长口径明确区分，读取elapsed_time_convention。
astro_vimshottari.scope: 120年是规则周期，不是寿命估计；读当前ruler的本命上下文，不能将边界写成事件必发生。
astro_vimshottari.full_export: 完整JSON或时间线导出首次fields=null，保留默认预算，从同run result_delivery取回。

astro_germany.native_layer: midpoint_analysis uses unrounded 22-factor geometry and a shared UTC/TT/UT1 policy. Sensitive-point equations double the midpoint period and orb; folded-only occupancy does not activate the direct source example. interpretations contains deduplicated, source-attributed symbolic claims only. Seven-planet top-level values also use raw coordinates.
astro_germany.birth_time_uncertainty: Pass user-confirmed birth_time_uncertainty_minutes (0..120), then read time_sensitivity. None is unknown, not exact. Samples vary recorded UTC before optional solar correction. Do not use event outcomes to choose a birth time, or report sample frequencies as confidence probabilities.
astro_germany.solar_arc: Only pass analysis_datetime when the user specifies a target instant with explicit timezone offset. The true solar arc uses actual tropical Sun displacement, including in the fixed natal Lahiri display. Directed coordinates are symbolic, not future observations; one source pattern only, no event guarantee. Read birth_time_sensitivity and preserve factor_layers. Read profile.sun_ephemeris_source for per-TT-epoch observations and file identities; natal/progressed sun_observation_indices and the daily target_sun_observation_index reference that shared batch. Equal TT epochs reuse one observation, not independent evidence. Different physical epochs may use different models, but each birth-time role must retain comparable sources. A source mismatch is a runtime-data error, not a birth-time effect; preserve the requested interval and repair its data coverage. At a supported nominal target, birth_time_sensitivity.status=partial can mean unavailable arcs or unresolved physical source references. Preserve all confirmed samples. For samples outside the declared0..150 Julian key-year domain, read computed_sample_count/unavailable_sample_count and sample.status/reason_code; do not substitute zero arc or infer absence. For computed arcs with unresolved MC, read source_pattern.resolved_condition_sample_count and unresolved_reference_sample_count and unresolved_reference_sample_indices; actual source_condition_met, source_direct_orb_degrees and directed_midheaven_longitude are null while backend_convention preserves formal values. Computed arc count is not resolved source-condition count. source_pattern.sampled_status=underdetermined is neither a known absence nor full-interval stability. Frequencies are not probabilities, and the key range is an implementation domain. The symbolic daily-meridian layer retains its own qualifications and unavailable samples.
astro_germany.daily_meridian: The selected Witte 1924 p.15 equation is solar_arc_analysis.daily_meridian: IC.day=IC.natal+solar_arc-Sun.natal.tropical+Sun.target.tropical, MC.day=IC.day+180. The actual target Sun is calculated separately in TT; symbolic meridians are not physical target angles or plain solar-arc MC. Read source_comparison: the printed 1923/1924 difference is explained by the natal VIII cusp offset in that historical example, not a universal 184 arcminute correction. A separate 4 arcminute printed sensitive-point residual remains. Full original time keys and real-world efficacy remain unaccepted; birth-time coordinate spans do not prove contact-set stability. For daily_meridian, preserve its own native MC reference qualification: unresolved dependent coordinates are null, backend_convention retains formal values, and actual Sun/arc data remain when computable. Read input_coherence for exact same-run native/grid/UTC/TT/observation-role binding, not independent astronomy. Separate unresolved_reference_sample_count from unavailable_sample_count; do not bridge unknown/unavailable adjacency or infer offsets from an unknown nominal reference. An unresolved ASC intersection alone does not restrict a resolved MC. A day_meridian_inputs503 is an internal source failure, not invalid birth data.
astro_germany.fictitious_elements: Read profile.hypothetical_element_source: library_builtin or first readable external seorbel.txt with SHA-256 and search-path index. Nonempty SE_EPHE_PATH takes precedence in Swiss. An external orbit file does not make fictitious bodies observed planets; factor element_name must match the Hamburg catalogue (Vulcanus/Vulkanus accepted). Changed files inside a factor/sample cohort are rejected; data should remain immutable during service runs.
astro_germany.two_factor: Native v3 dials include two_factor_contacts over 22 factors. A=B is a folded relation: read aspect_degrees, full-circle separation_degrees and signed_orb; factor_offset_degrees is the oriented A-B offset modulo 360, not a midpoint-axis offset. Never call every folded hit a conjunction. unique_two_factor_pair_count deduplicates unordered pairs across dials and is not independent prediction evidence. No source keywords are invented for these contacts.
astro_germany.birth_seconds: Pass birth_second only from an actually recorded clock or an explicitly identified historical clock conversion. Omission represents the start of the supplied minute, not evidence of exact seconds. Seconds propagate to UTC/TT/UT1, birth-time samples and optional directions; no outcome-driven rectification. Generic astro_chart admits recorded seconds for germany/chart13/india_chart; use the current published variant schema for its other clock options.
astro_germany.clock_basis: Use birth_clock_basis=civil for a recorded civil zone clock. Only an explicitly identified historical LMT/LAT record may select local_mean_solar/local_apparent_solar, with birth_timezone omitted and use_true_solar_time=false. These are input labels, not extra accuracy switches. Read actual person_info.clock_conversion (Germany under base_chart): input label, modeled physical UTC/UT1/TT, longitude, Sun/EOT where used, source/model and numerical residual. The UTC-named carrier before1960 is historical UT1, not atomic UTC. Never infer an ambiguous OZ basis or choose one by fitting positions/outcomes; a small numerical residual does not certify record precision or measured Earth rotation.
astro_germany.physical_ephemeris: Read midpoint_analysis.profile.physical_ephemeris_source for actual per-factor models and observed se1 context hashes/ranges/DE headers. Files, hypothetical orbit elements and Earth rotation are distinct. Birth-time samples reject changing per-factor models, same-name file contents or DE editions; acquire complete verified segments instead of dropping samples or silently downgrading. File identity is not accuracy certification, and NASA/Swiss may share DE441 dynamics. Source failures expose error_code=ephemeris_source_inconsistent, a named code in issues entries whose path is runtime.ephemeris_data, and retryable=false. This is runtime data, not changed birth information or an automatically retryable missing-package error. Complete the same interval data and reload before retrying. The base chart separately reports base_chart.chart_profile.physical_ephemeris_source. Its explicit orbital fallback may differ from the valid native midpoint layer; explain each layer from its own actual source and retain partial valid results. Ecliptic/equatorial states share one managed configuration; coordinate-source mismatches are errors, not reasons to silently use approximate orbits. ephemeris_model_scope=physical_bodies excludes the analytical mean node from physical model summaries; read nonphysical_factor_models and the node model swisseph_analytical_mean_node separately. Midpoint native_return_flags can echo the requested model and do not prove a vector-file source. A failed node still affects engine precision. Explicit strict JPL selection also governs the native Hamburg loop and fixed-star Earth observer; a limited kernel subset test does not certify full epoch coverage.
astro_germany.meridian_houses: meridian_houses is the selected Witte 1923 p.34 natal RA-divided cusp construction (Swiss X), not an equal-ecliptic house system. Cusp1 is the equatorial ascendant; physical Ascendant/Midheaven factors and base_chart houses are retained. Read the actual native angle TT, true obliquity, apparent Lahiri offset and same-run cusp samples. Native angle TT follows houses_ex UT1+deltat_ex and is recorded separately from shared TT; their difference is not a measured birth-clock error. The child factor_placement applies full ecliptic longitude/latitude to RA sectors; read its own source scope, factor counts and sample summary. Full progression time key, complete original interpretation and predictive efficacy remain unaccepted.

progression_key.purpose: 核对实际太阳弧年长钥匙及其与Witte1923推运常数原刊的关系。只在给定analysis_datetime时读取该层。
progression_key.source_boundary: 实际使用1个TT星历日/365.25个UTC日历日的FateBridge符号约定；不是该原刊常数法的完整实现。
progression_key.reading: 读取profile.key_policy/year_days/key_years/progressed_julian_day_tt与key_source_comparison。原刊八项时角运算有两项不一致，残差单位为时角时间秒；它们不属于当前命盘，不能加到用户钟时或黄经。民用夜间日期与正午起算天文日标签尚未独立裁定，不从事件反推。
progression_key.limits: 精确算术与真实接口一致性不证明原典整体、真实模型解释或现实预测已验收。

witte1925_table.purpose: 核对Witte1925原刊完整太阳弧表、数值插值和原载分步算例，不将其冒充当前盘的太阳弧。
witte1925_table.reading: 读取original_table_1925的source/coverage/worked_example/limitations。完整保留38行、342个年数格与38个末列值；20年列的一个不清楚度数标记会影响24个格的规范化，保持未知而不拿现代星历补值。
witte1925_table.rounding: 原文56分+54度17分+34分=55度47分的分步算术成立。未逐步舍入的数值扩展不是原典已确认算法，保留差值，不改原表和当前太阳弧。
witte1925_table.scope: 该字段computed_for_current_chart=false，只属于原表与历史例。已有真实出生与目标资料才调用德国盘读取此视图；纯原文问题据原刊解释，不编造出生或目标时刻。完整原典、闰日/亚日与跨年末列规则仍未验收。

meridian_placement.purpose: 读取Witte1924具名子午宫赤经落宫，不按黄经区间代替三维投影。
meridian_placement.coordinates: 使用同run原生黄经与黄纬；恒星显示先按天体同历元的实际视偏移还原回归黄经，投影交角与其原生角度历元另列。10物理天体、1解析平均月交点和8数学假设点分开计数，3个角点参考未纳入。
meridian_placement.reading: 按factor_placement.factors的id、kind、model、input_ecliptic_latitude、right_ascension、house/house_position和latitude_changes_house解读；longitude_only_control只是反事实诊断。样点读取birth_time_sensitivity.factor_placement_summary，变化时再读取同run time_sensitivity.samples.meridian_factor_positions。
meridian_placement.limits: 生时误差未知不补0；极点数值退化保留未定。原刊p59第11、12、2宫与两个预定交角模型尚未协调，不拟合勘误；几何关系不是整部原书、宫内关键词、寿命或现实事件预测的验收。

astro_germany.reference_angle_qualification: Read midpoint_analysis.profile.angle_definition and the affected factor/row reference_angle_basis. A numerically unresolved ASC remains a backend convention: retained coordinates and exact formal contacts do not establish resolved physical reference geometry. The same qualification follows directed factors and solar-arc contacts. Read each same-run time_sensitivity.samples angle_definition; an ASC factor span with status=underdetermined_ascendant has no physical interval bounds. MC, orbital factors and meridian houses are not restricted by this horizon degeneracy. Geographic-pole meridian conventions have their own scope; do not conflate them with unresolved intersections. For Germany source conditions, an exact geographic-pole MC is a supplied-meridian convention: read source_pattern.unresolved_reference_sample_count and source_pattern.unresolved_reference_sample_indices, resolved_condition_sample_count and condition_by_sample. Known present/absent counts exclude unknowns; backend_convention is formal evidence only. Unresolved source samples have null actual conditions/orbs/MC while computed solar arcs remain available. A source_application_status=underdetermined_reference_geometry reading states unknown applicability; backend_reading_zh is the former formal wording. Empty interpretations do not establish known absence. This differs from an unresolved ASC intersection with an independently resolved MC.
astro_germany.house_roles: Keep the selected base-chart12-house system separate from native reference-angle extraction, Meridian cusps and the custom13-sector partition. In the current numeric policy hsys1 is Alcabitus (SwissB), never Equal. Read actual chart_profile.house_system/house_system_code/house_system_label_zh; do not label a whole chart from a backend reference-angle call. reference_angle_model.house_code=E with cusp_output_used=false records only ASC/MC/ARMC extraction; samples carry their own model, and Germany solar-arc profile reuses the natal model. meridian_houses.profile.house_code=X identifies the separate RA cusp construction. fatebridge_equal13_v1 is the custom partition, independent of the selected12-house system. Unrecorded roles remain unknown; these labels do not establish original-text or predictive validity.
astro_germany.mixed_pairs: For a user-confirmed analysis_datetime, mixed_pair_geometry enumerates four-distinct-name natal/solar-arc mixed pairs under the same uniform arc. Read profile and contact_counts first. Each residual group retains four equivalent factor_layer_assignments; they are not four independent hits. midpoint_arc_coefficient=0 means arc_invariant: the uniform arc cancels, so do not interpret it as a new timing trigger. Coefficients +/-0.5 identify the additional mixed-pair relations; original homogeneous-pair contacts remain in the existing dials. Source motivation is Witte1925 pp53-54; this is a named algebraic reconstruction, not his full progression/transit method. Preserve reference_angle_basis and unresolved physical references. For a confirmed birth-time interval, read mixed_pair_geometry.birth_time_sensitivity. It evaluates the entire declared mixed-pair domain on the same-run finite grid, including nominally absent relations first appearing at samples. Read present/known-absent/unknown states, the separate backend matches, and unlisted-no-observed-hit counts; an unlisted group with unknown samples is not a proven absence. Both known true and false samples prove variation even if another sample is unknown. A missing arc affects only nonzero coefficients; coefficient0 may evaluate its natal relative geometry without substituting an arc or claiming directed coordinates outside the arc domain. Arc invariance does not imply birth-time invariance. Preserve unresolved physical reference names, every sample, actual input-clock endpoints, and partial status. The grid is neither a continuous proof nor a probability distribution. There are no new source-event keywords or validated event probabilities.
astro_germany.comparative_geometry: Witte1924 comparative_geometry reconstructs five stated anchor rotations and the four-point mirror system from the same native factors. Coordinates are symbolic; use the actual Aries Point for tropical axes in a sidereal display. An anchor coordinate fixed by definition does not resolve its physical reference or frame orientation. Unknown inputs stay null with backend conventions separate. Confirmed birth-time samples retain every native input; sampled signed offsets are not continuous bounds or probabilities. Four printed numeric rows remain uncoordinated, and the source Earth-house labels and event claims are not applied. This is not acceptance of the separate Rulesbook mirror chapter. When exact sample coordinates are needed, select the whole midpoint_analysis.comparative_geometry.birth_time_sensitivity.samples array in the first call, then read each item's point_systems; field projection cannot descend through an array; use the actual returned coordinates and qualifiers. Full JSON requires fields=null initially, then read that same run rather than rebuilding a full result from a summary.

astro_chart13.geometry: sector13 is an ascendant-relative equal partition, independent of the twelve-house selection; IAU constellations have different boundaries.
astro_chart13.birth_time_uncertainty: Pass user-confirmed birth_time_uncertainty_minutes (0..120), then read time_sensitivity. None is unknown, not exact. Samples vary recorded UTC before optional solar correction. Do not use event outcomes to choose a birth time, or report sample frequencies as confidence probabilities.
astro_chart13.birth_seconds: Pass birth_second only from an actually recorded clock or an explicitly identified historical clock conversion. Omission represents the start of the supplied minute, not evidence of exact seconds. Seconds propagate to UTC/TT/UT1, birth-time samples and optional directions; no outcome-driven rectification. Generic astro_chart admits recorded seconds for germany/chart13/india_chart; use the current published variant schema for its other clock options.
astro_chart13.clock_basis: Use birth_clock_basis=civil for a recorded civil zone clock. Only an explicitly identified historical LMT/LAT record may select local_mean_solar/local_apparent_solar, with birth_timezone omitted and use_true_solar_time=false. These are input labels, not extra accuracy switches. Read actual person_info.clock_conversion (Germany under base_chart): input label, modeled physical UTC/UT1/TT, longitude, Sun/EOT where used, source/model and numerical residual. The UTC-named carrier before1960 is historical UT1, not atomic UTC. Never infer an ambiguous OZ basis or choose one by fitting positions/outcomes; a small numerical residual does not certify record precision or measured Earth rotation.
astro_chart13.physical_ephemeris: Read chart_profile.physical_ephemeris_source for the actual nominal physical-body models, observed file hashes, ranges and DE headers; the analytical node is separate. Read time_sensitivity.physical_ephemeris_sources and each sample index for the grid. Nominal and sampled source cohorts are checked together, so a changing model or data edition cannot be interpreted as pure birth-time sensitivity. Source failures are error_code=ephemeris_source_inconsistent with named issues at runtime.ephemeris_data and retryable=false. Repair the runtime data, retain the original interval and repeat; source hashes are not accuracy certification or proof of atomic reads. ephemeris_model_scope=physical_bodies excludes the analytical mean node from physical model summaries; read nonphysical_factor_models and the node model swisseph_analytical_mean_node separately. Midpoint native_return_flags can echo the requested model and do not prove a vector-file source. A failed node still affects engine precision. Explicit strict JPL selection also governs the native Hamburg loop and fixed-star Earth observer; a limited kernel subset test does not certify full epoch coverage.
astro_chart13.reference_angle_qualification: When sector_profile.status=underdetermined_ascendant, no unique ASC-relative13-sector assignment exists: planets.sector13 and profile.anchor_longitude are null, thirteen_sectors is empty. backend_convention_* fields preserve replay values only. A null sector_by_sample is unknown, not a sector or absent condition; preserve every sample and computed_sample_count/unresolved_sample_count. Do not summarize known samples as full-interval stability or a probability. Ill-conditioned but resolved intersections and geographic-pole conventions retain their explicit angle_definition.
astro_chart13.house_roles: Keep the selected base-chart12-house system separate from native reference-angle extraction, Meridian cusps and the custom13-sector partition. In the current numeric policy hsys1 is Alcabitus (SwissB), never Equal. Read actual chart_profile.house_system/house_system_code/house_system_label_zh; do not label a whole chart from a backend reference-angle call. reference_angle_model.house_code=E with cusp_output_used=false records only ASC/MC/ARMC extraction; samples carry their own model, and Germany solar-arc profile reuses the natal model. meridian_houses.profile.house_code=X identifies the separate RA cusp construction. fatebridge_equal13_v1 is the custom partition, independent of the selected12-house system. Unrecorded roles remain unknown; these labels do not establish original-text or predictive validity.

astro_guolao.scope: guolao_research_v7; source ordinal life-palace counting with declared modern solar-palace/hour/term-endpoint conventions; life degree and mansion unresolved; modern equatorial research anchors; optional reference geometry reports unavailable cusps without changing functional palaces or substituting houses Apparent solar hour now reuses this run's geocentric Sun RA and estimated UT1 apparent sidereal angle. The solar display is a naive label, not a civil timezone or a new instant; measured DUT1 and physical subsecond accuracy are not certified. Read guolao.profile.apparent_solar_clock for operands and hour-boundary distance.
astro_guolao.solar_time: Recorded physical instant remains fixed; optional apparent solar clock determines birth-hour branch and may change life palace and dependent patterns.
astro_guolao.interpretation: Use this run guolao.bodies, palaces, rulesets, rule_trace and interpretation_evidence. For compatibility patterns read each rule_id and evidence.inputs/granularity; same-palace tests do not establish a life degree or exact conjunction. profile.pattern_model_id identifies the compatibility condition model; it is not classical or real-world certification.
astro_guolao.nobles: Native god_positions uses Lu Wei catalogue bundle vols.1-2 Tianyi day/Yutang night tables, including Wu/Geng same-branch exception. Read the disclosed year-boundary policy.
astro_guolao.purple: purple_model_audit distinguishes the facsimile printed 365.2564-du table from the author's 365.2575-du reference circle; the modern epoch remains unresolved. Source 中积 days are not Julian days or modern longitude; do not normalize or silently change the fit.
astro_guolao.reference_houses: angles, houses and planets.house are astronomical references in the selected zodiac; Lahiri houses use native Swiss sidereal cusps. Functional guolao.palaces are separately counted from source life branch, not replaced by astronomical houses. Read profile.reference_geometry: missing requested cusps yield houses=[] and planets.house=null; independently available angles may remain. Geographic poles have null reference angles. This partial reference layer does not negate calculated bodies, mansions or functional palaces.
astro_guolao.target_instant: Only pass analysis_datetime for an explicitly specified target instant with timezone offset, at or after recorded birth. Omission returns timing.status=not_requested, never implicit today. Read timing.small_limit with its LiChun research year policy and timing.transit_bodies for the actual geocentric target sky. Target sky has no observer angles or target location; natal_functional_palace refers to the natal reverse-counted palaces. Four extras retain disclosed models, including uncalibrated purple. This is not a complete classical temporal judgement or an event probability. Monthly limits are opt-in: pass guolao_month_basis=jie_month or chinese_lunar_utc8 together with analysis_datetime. The second policy uses fixed UTC+08 civil dates, never historical Shanghai DST or a true-solar display; intercalary birth/target months stay unassigned. These are explicit modern month-mapping research policies, not edition certification. Read timing.month_limit status and per-interpretation evidence before using the monthly result.
astro_guolao.ephemeris_policy: Read guolao.profile.ephemeris_provenance and, when requested, timing.profile.ephemeris_provenance. Seven physical bodies retain actual ecliptic/equatorial models and flags; incompatible frame models are rejected. Mean node/apogee and symbolic extras remain nonphysical. Fixed-star flags can echo SWIEPH while the actual Earth observer uses Moshier, so read both. Operator-selected strict JPL applies to the full required calculation, including year solar-term dependencies, and does not fall back. This provenance is not a complete file attestation, full original-text acceptance, absolute astronomical accuracy bound or outcome prediction certificate.
astro_guolao.longitude_motion: Seven physical bodies expose corrected tropical longitude_speed plus longitude_speed_native and separately reported correction terms. Read natal/target profile.longitude_motion for the actual model, native-version applicability, derivative convergence and observed file contexts. A selected sidereal zodiac changes zodiac_longitude, not these tropical rates. Mean/symbolic extras are unmodified. Guolao Moshier rates differentiate its own analytical apparent positions with version-gated binary-step and joint directional checks; nonconvergence stays explicitly unapplied. This does not remove physical-model error or enable the separate unsupported barycentric lunar light-time formula. No speed correction establishes precise station times, a classical judgement or real-world prediction.

sukuyo_compatibility.scope: 双方共用calendar_basis，默认现代中国农历UTC+08；可明确选择HuTime日本旧历逐日参考UTC+09。出生时区仍各自声明，不能由日本参考默认猜为东京；经纬度和物理星图不决定历日宿。
sukuyo_compatibility.leap_month: 默认档案unresolved保留同名月候选且不保证穷尽；repeat_month为明确约定。可选hinoo_t1299_host27在所选宿主历法上应用T2465闰月复用及小月补配，不称历史旧历复原。
sukuyo_compatibility.interpretation: 引用同run计算字段与版本、原典位置；未知或partial不补造宿名、距离、概率或结论。
sukuyo_compatibility.calendar_profile: 默认t1299_fullmoon27直接采用T1299下卷十五日望宿逆顺法及生日加十三的含首位算法，两法互核；NAOJ朔日表仅作独立交叉核验。
sukuyo_compatibility.textual_half: Hinoo短月补配的first_half/second_half必须明确给定；已知民用钟时不自动转换。闰月与补配规则次序未明时保留现代重建候选，不擅取唯一。
sukuyo_compatibility.candidates: candidate_relation_analysis为已列候选的条件组合，未代入primary；完整性标志限于所声明重建口径，排列不是排名。主关系为null时不得从某一行挑选确定相性。
sukuyo_compatibility.palace_reference: palace_reference仅按历日宿名查T1299上卷27宿四足/十二宫九足表；textual_pada是显式查表条件，不表示已排得出生足位。宫序不等星图House，太阳/太阴分不等昼夜生盘；不得据此断本命宫、现代月亮黄经或合成宫位相性。
sukuyo_compatibility.date_uncertainty: 未知出生时刻不补0点或中午。出生时区日期由date_support完整映射到所选UTC+08或UTC+09参考历日，calendar_candidates逐支保留农历、闰月/Hinoo候选，candidate_relation_analysis列日期来源。不能把某一候选或区间长度当主结果/概率；被整天跳过的当地日期应核对。完整候选若同宿，可只确定宿和关系，唯一历日和出生时刻仍未定；范围外分支使候选不穷尽。
sukuyo_compatibility.source_capture: 规则JSON的source_bundle_sha256与原文source_sha256分别核对；Hinoo的active_primary_evidence指向downloaded_primary_edition，交付SAT完整HTML响应指纹、选定原段及五条校记。旧cached_primary_excerpt是历史记录，其摘录哈希不等于完整响应或抄本哈希；旧末句句号与下载原文闭引号的差异明示。SAT原/甲本不合成唯一正文；完整HTML不等于字图全部取得、影印或独立学术校勘，半日钟时与规则次序仍未定。
sukuyo_compatibility.calendar_reference: 读取calendar_reference的日期来源类别、数据指纹、支持范围及资料差异。2015起是出版方参考推算，不能说成已核对逐年神宫原刊；固定UTC+09不是历史日本地方时。旧月度候选仍拒绝接入，新后端来自完整逐日事实；文档到2033与LOD到2031的差异继续保留，范围外不能换中国历补齐。
sukuyo_compatibility.historical_reference: 显式calendar_basis=japanese_naoj_historical_utc09使用NAOJ冻结月首参考，前推公历0001-01-01至1872-12-31、固定UTC+09；不因地点或古代出生年自动选择。阴历年0只作来源上下文，非公元0年输入。453阴历年及以前为儀鳳暦平朔回推；454起亦为具历史校正的参考，不能称当时颁历、观测或地方钟时已证明。
sukuyo_compatibility.historical_source_variants: NAOJ与HuTime1001.1完整月首对照保留210个分歧日期；calendar_reference.cross_source_comparison的control_fields未代入主结果，二者部分共用文献来源。即使配宿相同也须保留月/日/闰标志不同，不能称全历史历法一致。1872年旧历十二月只存两天；1873-01-01不延续旧历，不自动切现代日本参考。
sukuyo_compatibility.lower_date_boundary: 固定时差的公元1年边界以完整区间代数保留0000-12-31来源分支及UTC端点；这是天文年编号的计算标签，不能说成已支持公元0年出生或历史UTC实测。读取epoch秒及范围外分支，未知钟时不补造。
sukuyo_compatibility.historical_day_ganzhi: NAOJ历史参考的day_ganzhi_reference由原始日干支锚点和民用日数递推，日界固定UTC+09午夜；不代表八字日柱、古代地方日界或平明已验收。保留source_anchor和elapsed_civil_days；编年史日期对照仅覆盖明确列出的月与日，不能推广成全部历史颁历认证。
sukuyo_compatibility.shogonji_month_headers: 若返回manuscript_month_header，须解释该月首的原读、规范化候选、疑字／错位／未见朱注及非初一限制。荘厳寺37个月首来自1992研究作者转写，27条清晰、2条带限定、8处所选栏未见注；1092仅为月长合计，不能算逐日宿曜校勘或现实样本。1346／1347七月张注与Hinoo前半星不同，但朱注无半日钟时，不能判定规则胜负；1346闰九月两重建同氐，没有裁决次序的区分力。1345正文五行为纳音，非七曜。不能用渡边敏夫正文概表补缺注或据同名宿认证古代日界。 首年1345是作者归属；附录岁首字面康永二年与作者康永四年归属不同，同栏乙酉保留，未独立核原卷或认定刊误。四月朱印在一、二日之间，作者第232页说明3判断应属初一；这与宿注假名字形疑读分开解释。

suzhan.unknown_time: time省略/null只计算现有历法与事项证据；params.calculationMode=calendar_date_only，birthTimeImputed=false，chart/astronomy=null。input_normalized保留所选历法、时区与输入；经纬度、宫制和盘式选项没有用于日历层。读取calendar、candidate_days及每个日期的candidate_mansion_days，不把一个已列候选当已确定。不要为了取得星图补00:00、中午或示例钟时。

meihua_analysis.casting: 只支持年月日時取数；输入公历钟时，按指定时区查中国农历。不得把八字立春年柱代替农历年支。
meihua_analysis.conventions: 春节换年、民用午夜换日、闰月沿用本月数、节月季令是明示约定；不是原文唯一裁定。
