reading.purpose: 按实际原始资料起卦或解释已有卦，不补钟时、字音和笔画

audit.purpose: 核对所用原法、软件约定、原始数及取爻计数分歧

weather.purpose: 先读实际命中条文、制约资格、五/六位置计数差异及旧研究负结果；不以体用判晴雨，不把raw matched当成未受制天气断言
weather.when: interpretation_topic=weather时选择；需要的weather_context由已确认事实提供

weather_audit.purpose: 完整天气规则、计数、条件轨迹与来源；用于核对缺项和跨章制化候选
weather_audit.when: interpretation_topic=weather且需要审计细节时；沿用同run结果

topic.purpose: 核对所选文明书局本八章的初始体用条款及出行偏好、失物方位类象、行人初用参照、异文与各实际取数候选；不以通用吉凶取代章句

topic_audit.purpose: 完整所选题篇条款、异文及实际候选的原体用/互变/季令与爻辞参照
topic_audit.when: 八个显式题篇分支需要完整审计；沿用同run结果

text_count.purpose: 核对字数依据、软件扩展范围、计数候选与各自实际读法
text_count.when: casting.method=text_count，尤其超过100或两种取爻不同；不自动用此法替换声数或笔画

text_tones.purpose: 核对逐字四声、声明的音系与来源、实际原例类别比较和条件性解释
text_tones.when: casting.method=text_tones；不得以现代拼音调号或未核定古音自动填数

wealth.purpose: 核对所选求财初始条款与补充句关系成分、各候选及制约，保留并存关系
wealth.when: interpretation_topic=wealth；不按问题文字自动切换

external.purpose: 核对已报外应的形色／实物资格、原体及各取数候选；保留符号关系和所选原文的不同作用类别
external.when: 已确认外应类别及描述且选择人事分支；未知不补，weather不支持

stage_emphasis.description: 所报原文问事情境、内卦紧次及迟速／生克条件；整句条件适用不等于净作用或现实结局

stage_emphasis_audit.description: 所报原文问事情境、内卦紧次及迟速／生克条件；整句条件适用不等于净作用或现实结局

motion.description: 占者坐行立、实际外应动静与内卦符号角色分列；缺吉凶判断的条件保持待定，无日期或结局；端法且占者活动明确时另核除六前名义比例数及未知时间单位

observation_source.description: 核对已报端法类别、单一对象、八方参照、原例查表及实际起卦；不把来方改为相反行进方向

quiet.purpose: 静占已报条件与未知状态、内卦资料范围；不把未采集解释为无外应
quiet.when: 人事分支需要区别未采集与当次静室无所闻见声明时；不套天时占

day_qi.purpose: Selected day-qi, own-body and month/day qualifications; no full synthesis or reality claim
day_qi.when: Selected day-qi, own-body and month/day qualifications; no full synthesis or reality claim

situational.purpose: 已报同次方应、天时应、地理应、人事应与原体符号关系；多候选及异文分列
situational.when: 仅在已提供response_context时读取；未知现场资料省略，常规reading保留原输出；不用于天时预测分支

external_symbol.purpose: 所报金银世宝、兵刃的原体限定与实物资格分列；不把不凶改成吉或安全
external_symbol.when: 只有已报明确类别才选新manifestation，未知省略；旧金属或锐器不自动升级为新类别

obstruction_days.description: 生克并见时的条件化原文计日；明例与类推、实际角色、制约与候选分别保留，非净延迟或现实日期

trigram_symbols.purpose: 按本次原体与初用、体互、用互、变用的实际生体或克体关系，读取文明书局本16组八卦专属象义。各计数候选分列，保留受制和旺衰；或字为史料备选，不能推定现实人物、姓氏、方位、灾祸、诊疗、应期或已验证结果。所选巽克体南方等异文不以常识改字。
trigram_symbols.when: 比较相同五行却不同卦名的具体传统象义，或核对体用总诀原句与本次角色；天时分支为null

source_rules.purpose: 核对所选大限首宫、给定岁序的小限及正常生月斗君，并区分火铃年支定点读法与软件生时推进；不认证整书、年龄岁首或全部流月日时规则。

calendar.purpose: 核对原有出生安星、目标流曜、UTC+08参考时钟及岁序公式；同区岁序两端和旧规则差值另读age_calendar，实施来源另读calendar_sources，原典校时未认证。

childhood.purpose: 独立读取安童限诀明文一至六岁宫位及其真实本命星曜；后续岁序未决，未证明岁首或起大限前替代关系，不生成童限四化。

time_input.purpose: 核对真太阳时是否实际应用、经纬地点精度与时区假设；未计算分量为空，不把0修正或秒数显示解释为已知天文量或出生精度。

decade_activation.purpose: 核对给定岁序是否进入所选五行局首大限；未起时明确为空，与独立童限及其他五层分开。

sihua_source.purpose: 核对实际四化表身份、原页比较与是否显式应用；运限的各层实际四化另读同run scopes，运限复用未获原典认证。

limit_subperiods.purpose: 依当前已选虚岁及真实大限区间核上/下五年，保留未起限、南北斗原句及小限半年未定；分类不等于选出应验星曜或最终吉凶。

limit_subperiod_details.purpose: 首次请求本轮完整分段证据、南北斗定义与实际本命星位路径；双属与未分类星保留。若分页则沿同run取齐，不能将原句解释为已验证应验。

calendar_sources.purpose: 逐个排盘、钟表和UTC+08参考日期核实际库表／补表来源及分别发布的印刷见证；1900年参照TAM，紫台仅是所用一月补表，不把实现输入冒充独立验证或古典校时认证。

age_calendar.purpose: 核对同区岁序与旧混合时钟差异；出生安星及目标流曜仍各用已声明时钟，未认证原典岁首。

natal_prerequisites.purpose: 核对本次运限同次计算中已生成的本命前置链：出生排盘农历与时支、命身、年干、命宫干支、纳音与局数；保留条件原文比较，不拿目标年或岁序参考年替换出生年干。未另起本命run或认证原典岁首。

fixed_stars.when: 用户明确问恒星与本命星体／角度联系；读取实际命中与容许度，不将恒星标签当命定事件；核对同黄道、TT与星表来源，读取原典程度限定，未计算不等于无合相。

aspect_motion.when: 用户询问入相／出相、精确成相或光的传递／聚集；核对当前黄经与相对速度，精确、同速和速度未知分别保留。
aspect_motion.purpose: Instantaneous longitude motion only; inspect application_policy and aspect_motion before interpreting light configurations. No future perfection or complete source-method acceptance; not an event probability. Bodily latitude status is a separate bounded Western I.24 condition, possibly missing; it does not establish full bodily application.

solar_conditions.when: 询问日心、焦伤或日下；先核对Lilly 1647第113页的明文定义、同星座条件、实际状态及未解决的原文示例冲突。
solar_conditions.purpose: Named Lilly solar definitions only: 17 arcminutes, same-sign 8.5-degree combustion, 17-degree beams. Keep the contradictory printed ten-degree example and explicit boundary convention unresolved; no whole-page or event-validity certification.

solar_position_model.when: 核对近太阳位置的原生偏折模型、太阳后方的虚拟模型视位置与太阳前方的凌日几何。
solar_position_model.purpose: Read nominal-epoch finite unbent-ray geometry and the inspected native solar mass model. A background solar-disc position is a virtual continuous extension; foreground transits differ. Unknown geometry remains unknown. This is not an optical occultation, limb-contact, detectability or physical-error certificate. Never replace native positions with a no-deflection diagnostic to pass a reference comparison.

lilly_sign_rays.when: 核对Lilly1647第108–109页由求问者主星向所问主星发出的左相／右相、冲相、同星座和原表不相照关系，并与实际度数相位候选分别核对。
lilly_sign_rays.purpose: Caster-to-receiver direction from Lilly1647 pp108-109, separate from reception host/guest and Hellenistic overcoming. Preserve the32printed ordered inconjunct pairs and16pairs absent from both tables. Same-sign co-presence does not establish bodily conjunction. Compare the sign table to the selected degree/orb candidate without replacing it, adding strength points or certifying event perfection. Sidereal is an extension.

motion_conditions.when: 用户按明确提问时刻询问卜卦相位与传统条件；先读实际月亮事件、候选路径与未核验条件，原型规则倾向不能当作完整Lilly判断。
motion_conditions.purpose: Read actual lunar before-ingress and finite seven-planet TT event histories, nominal geometry, selected Lilly receptions and event-path conditions separately. Physical roots and named source predicates do not establish a complete source-method judgement; native failure and unsearched times remain unknown.

lilly_reception_conditions.when: 核对Lilly1647指定版本的本质尊贵、谁接纳谁、互纳与第125–126页路径的逐项条件；同时读取七曜原始状态与未核验项。
lilly_reception_conditions.purpose: Selected Lilly1647 seven-planet dignity/reception table and p125-126 route conditions, including actual finite event sequences in event_paths. Preserve receiver/guest direction, radical chart sect, event epochs, explicit numerical boundary ambiguity and selected p107 orb column, literal occupied-house facts and incomplete full house/epoch interpretation. Sidereal is an extension, not original-edition acceptance.

lilly_orbs_houses.when: 核对Lilly1647第107页两列容许度、第48／115页宫位事实，以及第126–127页不可仅凭居宫断成的条件。
lilly_orbs_houses.purpose: Read selected p107 full-orb column and declared equality convention; house is the significator role, occupied_house is actual chart occupancy. P48 rank assumes otherwise equal dignity; p115 house points are a separate partial row. P126-127 dwelling requires lunar transfer; finite ordered Moon contacts and current rays are necessary subconditions, not complete transfer, full judgement or reality proof. Preserve missing histories, collisions and numerical ambiguity.

event_paths.when: 核对主星、传光星与聚光星的实际历史／未来事件顺序、停滞折返及不同事件历元的接纳。
event_paths.purpose: Read actual seven-planet TT roots in the explicit ±30-day scan, distinct principal/principal and carrier/source prior contacts, all intervening carrier contacts, event-epoch receptions with numerical boundary uncertainty, and selected Lilly p111 prohibition/refranation patterns. Product radius and radical sect policies, unknown conditions, finite horizon, frame-specific station timing and incomplete whole-method acceptance remain explicit. A satisfied sequence subset is not a full judgement or outcome proof.

reference_points.when: 核对星历采用本体中心还是行星系统质心、物理后端与交点模型、以及成相／停滞所用日速来源。
reference_points.purpose: Read declared body/system centers and actual physical model summary separately from analytical nodes; inspect native speed and applied source-derived/display-frame corrections. Root brackets are numerical resolution. Matched-reference-point validation is not body-center accuracy, full original method or reality prediction certification. Unavailable event histories remain explicit; empty events do not establish absence.

solar_position_model.when: 核对近太阳位置的原生偏折模型、太阳后方的虚拟模型视位置与太阳前方的凌日几何。
solar_position_model.purpose: Read nominal-epoch finite unbent-ray geometry and the inspected native solar mass model. A background solar-disc position is a virtual continuous extension; foreground transits differ. Unknown geometry remains unknown. This is not an optical occultation, limb-contact, detectability or physical-error certificate. Never replace native positions with a no-deflection diagnostic to pass a reference comparison.

lilly_fortitudes.when: 逐行核对Lilly1647第115页本质／偶然尊贵表的已算条件、24小时运动与未知项。
lilly_fortitudes.purpose: Read all41-row summary including inapplicable and unknown conditions. Daily displacement differs from instantaneous direction; dated stellar astrometry differs from printed1647 coordinates. Literal row sums do not reproduce every original worked total. Expand fortitudes.planets.<Planet>.rows for exact predicates; unknown rows are not zero, and points are not success probabilities or a complete judgement.

lilly_fortune.when: 核对Lilly1647福点昼夜同式、宫头五度效力归属和第145页独立强弱表。
lilly_fortune.purpose: Lilly pp143-144 uses physical ASC+Moon-Sun day and night. Keep geometric occupancy, nearest-cusp virtue and significator roles separate. The28 p145 rows include neutral Aries and Fortune-specific sixth/eighth-house weights. Exact planetary rays and p179 stellar range transfer are disclosed conventions. P180 beyond-five-degree assignment and row discrepancies remain failed controls; unknowns never equal zero; no wealth amount, success probability or complete judgement follows.

lilly_radicality.when: 核对Lilly1647起盘审慎条件、时主对应、原文例外与未知定义，避免仅凭上升度数认定整盘可判断。
lilly_radicality.purpose: Read all12 clauses in the pp121-123 manual inventory, actual unequal-hour geometry, selected p104 triplicity and own-nature affinity, prerequisites, exceptions and attributed variants. The Moon late-degree cutoff is unspecified; no27degree threshold or p115 weighted balance0 is invented. Optional context is caller-reported only: a known question timestamp is not a certain timed event, and no age/appearance/strength is inferred. safe_to_judge remains null for the uncertified full method, not false/true reality prediction. Compute the supplied instant without changing it to clear a caution.

calendar_input.purpose: 核对显式儒略历／延伸格里历日期、转换后的本地钟时与实际TT/UT1；不推断地区改历、旧式年份或历史钟时，不把日期换算当原图复现。

clock_input.purpose: 核对已确认的民用／地方平太阳／地心视太阳钟时、历法转换次序及同一物理TT/UT1；未知原书钟时不拟合，数值残差不充当史料精度。

hour_origin.purpose: 核对已确认的午夜／正午起算小时标签：原历法日期、原小时与进位后的标准钟面分别读取，再看实际TT／UT1；不推断原图口径，不当作时区修正或实际持续时长。

physical_epoch.description: 输入钟时、原生TT/UT1及UTC显示标签；太阳时物理轴保留秒60。普通civil分支utc_representation可为null，未宣称原始资料或实测EOP已认证。

ut1_input.purpose: 核对明确选择的模型或IERS20 C04 UT1来源、固定覆盖期、源文件指纹、插值区间与未应用修正；盘面与地平计算仍要求覆盖内UT1；地心TT黄经事件不外推UT1即可跨边界搜索，未取得瞬时观测误差或现实预测证据。

sihua_source.purpose: 核对实际四化表身份、原页比较与是否显式应用；运限的各层实际四化另读同run scopes，运限复用未获原典认证。

calculation_conditions.when: 按明确候选时刻核对择日的原生月亮事件、太阳状态、物理ASC/MC、已知因子与未核算项；完整分数缺失时先读范围及原因。
calculation_conditions.purpose: Native TT lunar events and named physical axes, not house-cusp substitutes. Keep nullable score/hard status and fixed-policy bounds with unknown factor reasons. Solar states use selected Lilly1647 p113 definitions; old score weights/bands remain uncalibrated product policy, not full source judgement or outcome probability.

calendar_input.purpose: 核对显式儒略历／延伸格里历日期、转换后的本地钟时与实际TT/UT1；不推断地区改历、旧式年份或历史钟时，不把日期换算当原图复现。

clock_input.purpose: 核对已确认的民用／地方平太阳／地心视太阳钟时、历法转换次序及同一物理TT/UT1；未知原书钟时不拟合，数值残差不充当史料精度。

hour_origin.purpose: 核对已确认的午夜／正午起算小时标签：原历法日期、原小时与进位后的标准钟面分别读取，再看实际TT／UT1；不推断原图口径，不当作时区修正或实际持续时长。

physical_epoch.description: 输入钟时、原生TT/UT1及UTC显示标签；太阳时物理轴保留秒60。普通civil分支utc_representation可为null，未宣称原始资料或实测EOP已认证。

ut1_input.purpose: 核对明确选择的模型或IERS20 C04 UT1来源、固定覆盖期、源文件指纹、插值区间与未应用修正；盘面与地平计算仍要求覆盖内UT1；地心TT黄经事件不外推UT1即可跨边界搜索，未取得瞬时观测误差或现实预测证据。

birth_time_sensitivity.when: 用户已确认出生参考的正负UTC经过分钟范围；读取全部分钟及事件候选、原始分量省略事实与未决层。事件探针不是观测频率，包络未认证连续极值。

analysis_clock.when: 核对同次完整分析瞬间、UTC偏移/fold及分析日期的补齐来源；不把默认月初、月中或整点当成当前。
核对同次完整分析瞬间、UTC偏移/fold及分析日期的补齐来源；不把默认月初、月中或整点当成当前。

life_index.label: 五维规则索引与实际计算范围
life_index.purpose: 核对连续标度版本、参与层、不可用大运及未知爱情。不同层集合不可直接比较，规则索引不是概率或心理测量；视图名不是请求参数。

energy_sources.label: 同次身印等五类能量来源
energy_sources.purpose: 分开真实藏干、支合成贡献和非日干天干，按未舍入回执核对能量闭合；不把合成贡献当物理根，不据工程分量认证原典身印轻重、月令司令或通关成立。缺失回执保留未知，不重算盘。视图字段复制到fields，视图名不是请求参数。

branch_candidates.label: 合会候选与同次筛选回执
branch_candidates.purpose: 保留现有v8目录中的完整局、字面六合及含旺支半合候选，包括被冲、占位或邻接条件筛掉的图形。候选、筛选与实际事件分别解释，不据候选认定合化、通关或旺衰；未提供或未知方法保留未知。视图字段复制到fields，视图名不是请求参数。

source_strength.label: 字面四柱与强弱编释核对
source_strength.purpose: 读取当前计算、全部同柱记录及差异或未知；不是原典或预测准确率

source_conditions.label: 原19例的原页条件校读
source_conditions.purpose: 所选原页的开发者条件校读，按旧命例及来源逐项保留身印、通关及原文相对时序；不重判旧标签，不据相对天数推定出生瞬间或司令生效，不认证独立专家或模型解释验收。视图字段复制到fields，视图名不是请求参数。

sources.scope: Reference catalogue by explicit domain, or mixed domains with separate source identities. keys_sample is a declared sample, not the complete key space or reviewed coverage.

human_design_line_reference.scope: Only domain=human_design: complete384line locator/polarity index; actual registry coverage separates pending local paraphrases, uncurated meanings and independent semantic acceptance. Preserve source conditions and unknown personal applicability. Source facts are not personal fixing states. Keep same-run calculation evidence separate; no complete original-source, publisher-master or real-world efficacy certificate.

numerology_reference.scope: For domain=heluo/canping only. Preserve original source identity, actual column and part-specific review status. Reference roles do not select personal applicability or dated periods. Full source objects remain in reference_details.record; use fields=null for a complete export and read the same retained delivery.

measured_workstation.scope: Requires workstation_layout. Measured facts, source-scoped role/period conditions and independently selected desktop rules. Preserve unknowns, coordinate frames and source disagreement; view name is not a request parameter.

measured_workstation_search.scope: Requires explicit workstation_layout.search. Preserve every finite-search receipt and rejection, frontier IDs and display omissions. Read deferred evidence from the same run; ready only describes geometry and action permissions, not universal auspiciousness.
